title: Group ma Dhamaal: asked for ₹300 UPI, the whole group vanished
concept: Chat v3 pilot (31 s, Gujlish): cold open with the twist ('Kunal left') on frame one, then '2 minutes earlier'; the friends' movie plan escalates to 'everyone UPI ₹300'; Kunal leaves (punch-in + shake), Dhruv's fake no-network voice note, Neha's 'Mummy is calling', 'even the popcorn guy is gone?'. Why share: everyone has this friend; tag/send to the group. Aim: tags and shares. Test: does chat v3 (cold open + punch) beat chat v2's 72-89% skip rate?
